---
title: "Pulse — 주간 변화"
subtitle: "Rule-based delta · 매주 무엇이 바뀌었는가"
---

각 주의 commit 분포, 신규 repo/topic, 무게중심 org를 자동으로 추출합니다. LLM 생성 narrative는 v1에서 의도적으로 제외 — N≈2.7 commits/week에선 hallucination 위험이 큽니다.

::: {.callout-tip appearance="simple"}
가장 최근 주가 자동으로 펼쳐져 있습니다. 다른 주는 ▶ 클릭으로 펼쳐보세요.
:::

```{=html}
<div id="pulse-list" style="margin-top: 24px;"></div>

<script type="module">
// Rendered twice from the same source: the public profile reads the redacted
// data/pub, the lab profile (QUARTO_PROFILE=lab) reads data/lab.
const ROOT = window.AA_DATA_ROOT ?? "data/pub";

const [pulse, topicsDoc] = await Promise.all([
  fetch(`${ROOT}/weekly_pulse.json`).then(r => r.json()),
  fetch(`${ROOT}/topics.json`).then(r => r.json()),
]);

const topicById = new Map(topicsDoc.topics.map(t => [t.topic_id, t]));
const container = document.getElementById("pulse-list");

pulse.forEach((week, i) => {
  const details = document.createElement("details");
  details.className = "pulse-week";
  if (i === 0) details.open = true;

  const summary = document.createElement("summary");
  const topTopicLabels = (week.top_topics || [])
    .map(tid => topicById.get(tid))
    .filter(Boolean)
    .map(t => `<span class="topic-chip" style="background:${t.color}; padding:2px 8px; font-size:0.75rem;">${t.label}</span>`)
    .join("");
  summary.innerHTML = `
    <span style="font-size:1.05rem; margin-right:12px;">${week.week_iso}</span>
    <span style="color: var(--aa-snu-gray); margin-right:12px;">${week.commit_count} commit${week.commit_count > 1 ? "s" : ""}</span>
    ${topTopicLabels}
  `;
  details.appendChild(summary);

  const ul = document.createElement("ul");
  for (const bullet of week.delta_bullets) {
    const li = document.createElement("li");
    // Convert markdown-ish `code` to <code>
    li.innerHTML = bullet.replace(/`([^`]+)`/g, '<code>$1</code>');
    ul.appendChild(li);
  }
  details.appendChild(ul);

  container.appendChild(details);
});
</script>
```
